caption:
Lazy girl pasta salad vibes only! 😎🍝

Here’s what you need:

-2 cups dry pasta, cooked

Dressing Ingredients: 
-300g high-protein Greek yogurt (I went with Epigamia)
-1 onion, chopped
-3 garlic cloves, minced
-1 tsp balsamic vinegar
-1 small tsp whole grain mustard
-Salt + pepper to taste
-Red chili flakes / paprika for that kick 🔥

Mix-ins:
-6 slices of salami
-30g cheddar (or any cheese you’re feeling!)
-Add whatever veggies you like—TBH, I kept it simple 😜

How to make it:

-Cook pasta & let it cool.
-Mix dressing ingredients in a bowl.
-Add pasta, cheese, and salami. Toss it all together.
-Serve fresh or chill in the fridge for a few hours—flavors get even better! ✨
